data.one_liner: Android implementation of the webview_flutter plugin providing a WebView widget.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that provides a WebView widget specifically for Android. It supports features like Payment Request API, Web Authentication, geolocation prompts, and custom fullscreen video widgets.
use_when: You need to embed web content inside your Flutter application on Android.
You need access to Android-specific webview configurations like WebAuthn or Payment Request API.
avoid_when: You are building a cross-platform application where platform-specific Android API calls are unnecessary and you should use webview_flutter instead.
You want a pure web app without native mobile wrappers.
strengths: Endorsed federated plugin which automatically integrates when using webview_flutter.
Provides fine-grained Android-specific APIs such as Web Authentication and custom widget callbacks.
weaknesses: Platform-specific to Android, requiring other implementations for iOS or desktop.
Performance trade-offs between Hybrid Composition and Texture Layer display modes.
data.setup_notes: Automatically included when using webview_flutter. Add intent filters in AndroidManifest.xml if using Payment Request features.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: The main federated package that includes this Android implementation along with other platforms.
